meta.convention: Tithi and nakshatra sampled at 06:00 IST; amānta lunar months; Chennai; adhika months carry no festivals
meta.sharedWith: NalNaal (tamil-nal-app/generate_panchangam.py) — same engine, same conventions, on purpose
meta.caveat: Computed. A festival is placed on the day carrying its tithi at 06:00, which is NOT how observance is fixed — madhyahna, nishita, pradosh and midnight rules each move some of them by a day. content/panchanga-overrides.json is the correction layer and the source of truth; see its _candidates list for the known disagreements.
